hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A general-purpose hook that maintains a per-pool buyback pot funded by swap fees. On every afterSwap, it auto-harvests fee splits, observes the current tick against a 10-minute time-weighted reference, and executes a nested buy of the pool's designated main asset from the secondary token. A spend bucket paced by fee accrual limits pump size per swap. Supports configurable LP programs with autocompound, burn, and fee-split options.
